Wind energy will become a large-scale renewable and clean energy source developed in the 21st century. Wind turbines are devices that convert wind energy (the kinetic energy of airflow) into electrical energy. Their main components include wind turbines, gearboxes, generators, etc. As shown in the figure, do not add any other content.

1. The area swept by the rotation of wind turbine blades is the area through which the wind turbine can capture wind energy. Let the air density be $\rho$, the wind speed be $v$, and the length of the wind turbine blades be $r$. Determine the maximum wind energy $P_{m}$ flowing towards the wind turbine per unit time.
2. The electrical power output $P$ of a wind turbine is proportional to $P_{m}$. A certain wind turbine can output an electrical power of $P_{1} = 540 \, \mathrm{kW}$ at a wind speed of $v_{1} = 9 \, \mathrm{m/s}$. In a certain region of China, the wind speed is not less than $v_{2} = 6 \, \mathrm{m/s}$ for approximately 5,000 hours per year. Estimate the minimum annual electricity generation of this wind turbine in the region in kilowatt-hours.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows a wind turbine. The turbine blades rotate within a dashed circular swept disk, and the blade length is labeled r, which is the radius of that swept circle. The figure also labels the gearbox and generator on the right, but these parts are not needed for the calculation. Reasoning: The swept capture area is A = πr^2. In unit time, the volume of air passing through this area is Av, so the mass flow rate is ρAv. The kinetic energy per unit mass of the wind is v^2/2. Therefore the maximum wind energy flowing toward the turbine per unit time is P_m = (ρAv)(v^2/2) = (1/2)ρπr^2v^3. For the same turbine, electrical power P is proportional to P_m, so P ∝ v^3. Thus at v_2 = 6 m/s, P_2 = 540(6/9)^3 kW = 540(2/3)^3 kW = 160 kW. Over 5000 h, the minimum annual electricity generation is E = 160 × 5000 = 800000 kW·h = 8 × 10^5 kW·h.

method.method_draft: First describe the figure: the blades sweep out a circular region shown by the dashed circle, and the marked length r is the radius, so the rotor intercepts a circular column of wind of cross-section pi r^2. Take an arbitrary time interval Delta t. In that time, the wind advances a distance v Delta t through the swept disk, forming an air cylinder of volume pi r^2 v Delta t and mass rho pi r^2 v Delta t. Its kinetic energy is (1/2)(rho pi r^2 v Delta t)v^2; dividing by Delta t gives P_m = (1/2)pi rho r^2 v^3. Then introduce a constant conversion factor C for this particular turbine, P = C v^3, since all other factors and efficiency are fixed. Determine the low-wind power by ratio without finding C explicitly: P_min/P_1 = (v_2/v_1)^3 = (6/9)^3, so P_min = 160 kW, and annual generation is 160 kW × 5000 h = 8 × 10^5 kW·h.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一台风力发电机示意图，左侧有风轮叶片，叶片旋转形成一个虚线圆形区域；图中标出的 r 对应从转轴中心到虚线圆边缘的距离，即叶片长度，也就是扫掠圆的半径。右侧标有 gearbox 和 generator，表示齿轮箱和发电机。
推理：风轮能捕获风能的截面积为叶片扫过的圆面积 A=πr^2。取时间间隔 Δt，风以速度 v 穿过该圆面，前进距离为 vΔt，因此通过风轮扫掠面的空气体积为 V=πr^2vΔt。空气质量 m=ρV=ρπr^2vΔt。这部分空气的动能为 E_k=(1/2)mv^2=(1/2)ρπr^2vΔt·v^2。单位时间内流向风轮的最大风能为 P_m=E_k/Δt=(1/2)πρr^2v^3。
由于该风力发电机的输出电功率 P 与 P_m 成正比，而 P_m∝v^3，所以对同一台风机有 P=Cv^3。已知 v_1=9 m/s 时 P_1=540 kW。当风速至少为 v_2=6 m/s 时，最低输出功率按 v_2 计算：P_min/P_1=(v_2/v_1)^3=(6/9)^3=(2/3)^3=8/27。因此 P_min=540×8/27=160 kW。该地区每年风速不低于 6 m/s 的时间约为 5000 h，所以最低年发电量为 160 kW×5000 h=8.0×10^5 kW·h。
method.model_answer:
1. P_m=\frac{1}{2}\pi\rho r^2v^3。
2. 最低年发电量约为 8\times10^5\ \mathrm{kW\cdot h}。

Estimate the minimum annual electricity generation of this wind turbine in the region in kilowatt-hours.
ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Wind energy will become a large-scale renewable and clean energy source developed in the 21st century. Wind turbines are devices that convert wind energy (the kinetic energy of airflow) into electrical energy. Their main components include wind turbine blades, gearboxes, generators, etc. As shown in the figure: 1. The area swept by the rotation of wind turbine blades is the area through which the wind turbine can capture wind energy. Let the air density be $\rho$, the wind speed be $v$, and the length of the wind turbine blades be $r$. Determine the maximum wind energy $P_m$ flowing towards the wind turbine per unit time. 2. The electrical power output $P$ of a wind turbine is proportional to $P_m$. A certain wind turbine can output an electrical power of $P_1 = 540\,\mathrm{kW}$ at a wind speed of $v_1 = 9\,\mathrm{m/s}$. In a certain region of China, the wind speed is not less than $v_2 = 6\,\mathrm{m/s}$ for approximately 5,000 hours per year. Estimate the minimum annual electricity generation of this wind turbine in the region in kilowatt-hours.
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows a wind turbine. The turbine blades rotate within a dashed circular swept disk, and the blade length is labeled r, which is the radius of that swept circle. The figure also labels the gearbox and generator on the right, but these parts are not needed for the calculation. Reasoning: The swept capture area is A = πr^2. In unit time, the volume of air passing through this area is Av, so the mass flow rate is ρAv. The kinetic energy per unit mass of the wind is v^2/2. Therefore the maximum wind energy flowing toward the turbine per unit time is P_m = (ρAv)(v^2/2) = (1/2)ρπr^2v^3. For the same turbine, electrical power P is proportional to P_m, so P ∝ v^3. Thus at v_2 = 6 m/s, P_2 = 540(6/9)^3 kW = 540(2/3)^3 kW = 160 kW. Over 5000 h, the minimum annual electricity generation is E = 160 × 5000 = 800000 kW·h = 8 × 10^5 kW·h.
